result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6514). The purchase-order subquery had no status filter. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and latest-PO queries use, and noted the exclusion in the Javadoc. Nothing else changed, and the sort and zero-count behaviour are untouched.

**Tests:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (3 run, 0 failures). The existing tests don't cover a cancelled purchase order, so the fix is not tested by a regression test. I didn't add one, to keep the change small. Say if you want one.

Nothing is committed.
